title: Traditional jazz versus Dixieland: the beat
summary: Barnes says old musicians confuse traditional New Orleans jazz with Dixieland and explains the parade beat, the final-chorus switch to four beats and boogie woogie.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
